summary: Alamar Biosciences, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its initial public offering (IPO) of 12,937,500 shares of common stock (including full exercise of the underwriters' option for 1,687,500 shares) at $17.00 per share, with aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $219.9 million. The filing also covers amendments to its certificate of incorporation and bylaws effective upon IPO closing. This is a routine post-IPO filing, not a special situation. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The offering is a standard capital-raising event, not a special situation category.
